theme_identity.name: Halo CE Sapien & SparkEdit Tactical Windows Classic Chrome
theme_identity.description: A dark tactical level-editor UI combining Sapien's modular dockable panel hierarchy and SparkEdit's toolbar/tabbed utility workflow. Features sunken panel borders, dense tree views, property grids, status bars, action toolbars with retro tactical accents (Halo Covenant Cyan, UNSC Olive Green, Caution Gold), and clear docked placeholder slots for future 3D Viewport and Sapien tools.

layout_architecture.type: Docked Multi-Pane Level Editor (Sapien + SparkEdit Hybrid)

structure.top_menu: Compact Windows style MenuBar (File, Tools, View, Help) with dark drop-downs
structure.primary_toolbar: SparkEdit-style action toolbar with quick buttons (Open, Save, Decompress, Recompress, Extract, Inject, Reset Layout)
structure.main_workspace: 3-column grid/flex layout with customizable or collapsable panes:
structure.left_pane: Sapien Hierarchy View & Tag Browser (Search bar, Class vs Folder Toggle, Multi-select Tree with checkboxes, Size/TagID columns)
structure.center_pane: SparkEdit Tabbed Main Viewport / Content Area (Map Overview & Header Details, Active Tag Inspector/Hex/Data, Compressed Map Alert Banner, 3D Viewport Reserved Slot)
structure.right_pane: Sapien Properties Palette & Asset Tool Inspector (Metadata properties, Tag Header footprint, Quick Actions, Dependency Tree view)
structure.bottom_pane: Sapien/SparkEdit Log Console & System Status Bar (Real-time operations log, CRC32 info, Map Compression state, Memory footprint)

component_guidelines.required_data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, tabs, menu items, search inputs, checkboxes, tree rows, dialog triggers) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="open-map-btn", data-testid="tag-browser-tree", data-testid="decompress-map-btn").

components.name: MenuBar
components.description: Classic application top menu with dropdowns (File, Tools, View, Help). Never transparent. Uses dark dropdowns with high contrast options.

components.name: ToolBar
components.description: SparkEdit classic toolbar with icon buttons, tooltips, map status badge, and mode toggles.

components.name: HierarchyTagBrowser
components.description: Sapien-style left pane hierarchy tree for tags and scenario categories. Supports filter, multi-selection, and extraction.

components.name: MainViewportTabs
components.description: Center editor tab bar featuring Map Info, Tag Data Inspector, and Reserved 3D Scenario Viewport.

components.name: PropertiesPalette
components.description: Right pane showing attribute key-value table for selected tag or scenario element.

components.name: LogConsole
components.description: Bottom dock panel displaying color-coded log output (info, success, warning, error) with copy/clear controls.

components.name: StatusBar
components.description: Bottom edge status bar showing map file path, compression mode, CRC32, and tag count.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Ensure 100% desktop app feel without web dashboard anti-patterns.
Borders must be crisp (1px solid #30363D) with subtle bevels/shadows reminiscent of professional level editors.
Never use full transparent backgrounds on overlays, menus, or headers.
Provide clear visual cues for compressed vs decompressed maps with high contrast banner alerts.
Ensure tree nodes and lists have clear hover and active selection states with data-testid attributes on every key row and button.
